name: Npc Trainer
description: Spells taught by a trainer creature (entry = creature_template entry, the creature must have the trainer npc flag). Spells listed here are added on top of any shared list assigned via creature_template.TrainerTemplateId and must not duplicate it.

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Creature entry of the trainer (creature_template), must have UNIT_NPC_FLAG_TRAINER.

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: Spell taught by the trainer (usually a learn-spell whose trigger is what the player actually gets). Must not be a talent and must be a valid spell.

fields.name: Spell Cost
fields.help: Copper cost to learn the spell from the trainer.

fields.name: Req Skill Value
fields.help: Minimum skill value required in Req Skill.

fields.name: Req Level
fields.help: Minimum player level required (0 = use the taught spell's own spell level, or the profession min level for profession spells).

fields.name: Req Ability 1
fields.help: Optional prerequisite spell the player must already know.

fields.name: Req Ability 2
fields.help: Optional prerequisite spell the player must already know.

fields.name: Req Ability 3
fields.help: Optional prerequisite spell the player must already know.

fields.name: Condition Id
fields.help: conditions.condition_entry controlling whether this spell is offered to a given player, 0 = always offered.

fields.name: Condition
fields.help: Edit the condition tree referenced by Condition Id.
